title: Minimalist Vector
description: Illustration vectorielle contemporaine et épurée, caractérisée par des palettes pastel douces, des personnages sans visage et un éclairage directionnel doux. Les formes sont définies par des bords nets et des dégradés subtils sans contours, créant une atmosphère calme.
description_en: Clean, contemporary vector illustration characterized by muted pastel palettes, faceless figures, and soft directional lighting. Shapes are defined by crisp edges and subtle gradients rather than outlines, creating a calm, editorial atmosphere.
description_fr: Illustration vectorielle contemporaine et épurée, caractérisée par des palettes pastel douces, des personnages sans visage et un éclairage directionnel doux. Les formes sont définies par des bords nets et des dégradés subtils sans contours, créant une atmosphère calme.
prompt: Contemporary flat vector illustration style, reminiscent of sophisticated modern editorial art. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space, full bleed to all four corners with no margins or borders. Render the scene using crisp, geometric vector shapes and flawlessly smooth gradients, completely devoid of visible brushstrokes, organic textures, or harsh outlines. Form and depth are defined entirely by exact color boundaries and layered planar composition. Utilize a muted, calming color palette featuring a foundation of {{primary_color}}, structured with {{secondary_color}} midtones, and punctuated by restrained {{accent_color}} details. The lighting anatomy features soft but distinct directional illumination, casting sharp, low-contrast, semi-transparent shadows that anchor elements within the space. Curved surfaces receive gentle, seamless volumetric shading to prevent absolute flatness. The surface materiality is pristine, matte, and uniform. Any human figures must follow a minimalist aesthetic, often faceless or lacking intricate anatomical detail, focusing instead on stylized posture and silhouette.
